Bright lively harbor adventure with deep blue #14364A rounded outlines, sea teal #2BA9A1, deep water #176B87, foam #EAF9F4, coral #F47B61, sand #E9C77C, rare violet #7656C9, upper-left warm daylight, three-tone cel shading, side-view entities and 3/4-side props. No realistic fish scales or eyes, horror sea creature, thin fishing line baked into the character sprite, monster-like violet magic, text on signs/UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, copyrighted characters, artist imitation, photorealism, or external asset collage. Keep all components internally consistent in silhouette, outline, palette, lighting, projection, and rendering density.
